site.title: NextLink MW | IT Solutions Malawi
site.description: Custom software, IT infrastructure, and network solutions for businesses in Malawi.

hero.subtext: Custom software. Network infrastructure. Financial systems. IoT. If your business has an IT problem that spreadsheets and off-the-shelf software can't fix — that's exactly what NextLink MW is for.

services.label: What We Build
services.title_line2: Your Business — Not the Other Way Round
services.subtext: Every system is built from scratch for your specific workflows. No bloated templates, no licensing fees, no features you'll never use.

items.title: POS & Retail Systems
items.body: Sales, stock, receipts, daily reports. Works offline. Scales from a single till to a multi-branch operation.

items.title: Lodge & Hotel PMS
items.body: Room bookings, check-in/out, invoicing, housekeeping status. Everything a property needs to stop losing money to manual processes.

items.title: School & College Systems
items.body: Enrollment, timetables, grades, fee collection, and parent communication — all in one place, maintained by your own staff.

items.title: SACCO & MFI Systems
items.body: Member accounts, loan management, savings ledgers, interest calculations, and USSD mobile banking — RBM-aware and audit-ready.

items.title: Farm & Agri Management
items.body: Track livestock, crop cycles, inputs, harvests, and sales. Built for operations that run in the field, not just on a desktop.

items.title: Android Mobile Apps
items.body: Native Kotlin apps that connect to your backend and work the way your team actually works — fast, offline-capable, no browser required.

items.title: Business Websites & CMS
items.body: Professional websites your staff can update without calling a developer. SEO-ready, mobile-friendly, and actually maintained.

items.title: IoT & Automation
items.body: ESP32 and Raspberry Pi solutions for monitoring, control, and automation — sensor dashboards, MQTT pipelines, relay systems.

items.title: Network & Infrastructure
items.body: Cisco switches and routers, Windows Server, Active Directory, VPN, CCTV, VMware virtualisation, structured cabling — designed to stay up.

why.label: Why NextLink MW
why.title_line1: Not a Tech Company That Learned About Malawi.
why.panel_body: Most software sold in Malawi was built for somewhere else and retrofitted. NextLink MW builds for Malawian workflows, Malawian connectivity, and Malawian scale — from day one.

items.title: 5+ Years Managing Real Infrastructure
items.body: Full IT operations for financial institutions in Malawi — not just consulting, actually running the systems day to day.

items.title: One Person. Full Stack. No Handoffs.
items.body: From network cabling to the mobile app your staff uses. One point of contact, one person accountable for the whole thing.

items.title: RBM-Compliant & Audit-Ready
items.body: MUSCCO and MFI-Hub experience. Financial software built to meet Reserve Bank of Malawi data security requirements.

items.title: Works in Rural Malawi. Not Just on Paper.
items.body: Offline-first design, low-bandwidth optimisation, and support that doesn't require you to be in Lilongwe to get a response.

projects.label: Proof of Work
projects.title: Things We've Actually Shipped
projects.subtext: A selection of projects built, deployed, and being used by real people right now.

items.title: Unique SACCO Platform
items.body: Live SACCO website with member portal and floating CMS panel. Non-technical staff manage content without touching code. Real accounts. Real transactions.

items.title: Karonga Village Bank
items.body: Full village banking system for Bank Mmuzi — member registration, savings accounts, loan tracking, and repayment schedules. Runs on a single machine, no internet required.

items.title: Next Smart Home
items.body: Home automation stack built on ESP32 — MQTT over TLS, real-time WebSocket dashboard, Android control app. Relay switching, PWM, and sensor monitoring from your phone.

items.title: Nganjo OS
items.body: Custom Arch Linux distribution — GNOME on Wayland, pre-configured for a developer workstation. Ships as a bootable ISO. Used daily as a primary OS.

items.title: Atarah Assistant
items.body: AI assistant built from scratch — voice input, persistent memory, reasoning engine, and desktop system integration. Not a wrapper around someone else's API.

items.title: Bet Neural
items.body: Football match outcome predictor — Poisson regression + ensemble ML trained on six years of match data across seven European leagues. Consistently outperforms pundit consensus.

contact.label: Get In Touch
contact.title: Got a Project in Mind?
contact.subtext: Tell us what you're trying to build or fix. If it's doable, we'll tell you how. If it's not, we'll tell you that too.
